messages.author: 03290ff051991093
messages.subject: Getting Data to HDFS
parts:
All, 

Is there a "preferred" way to get my data to HDFS? I'm thinking about rhdfs::hdfs.write versus rmr2::to.dfs. What are the conceptual differences between the two? 

Thanks, 
M

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1276] Getting Data to HDFS
parts:
to.dfs is meant to write data to be read in mapreduce and from.dfs. So if you write it out with hdfs.write, forget mapreduce. If you never use mapreduce, it seems to me rhdfs has the big advantage of not requiring a cluster installation, whereas rmr2 does. 


Antonio
On Thu, Jan 30, 2014 at 3:05 AM, Michael Smith <my.r...@gmail.com> wrote:

All, 

Is there a "preferred" way to get my data to HDFS? I'm thinking about rhdfs::hdfs.write versus rmr2::to.dfs. What are the conceptual differences between the two? 

Thanks, 
M
